title: Calls, SMS and WhatsApp: reach people clearly and safely

say: Calls, SMS and WhatsApp: reach people clearly and safely.
This is the video for Module 2 of Smartphone and Digital Awareness: communicating with your smartphone.
A smartphone gives you more control over calls. You can put a call on speaker, mute yourself, or press 1 when a customer line asks.

say: For example, Joy sells fabric in Aba. A customer writes her number on paper. Joy wants it to work for calls, SMS and WhatsApp, even when she travels. That needs the international format.

say: The number has 11 digits, starting with 0. This is a made-up example.

panel.heading: Saving a number in +234 format
items: Save it and test the call

say: She removes the first 0.

panel.heading: Saving a number in +234 format
items: Save it and test the call

say: She puts plus 234 in front. 234 is Nigeria's country code.

panel.heading: Saving a number in +234 format
items: Save it and test the call

say: Now it has 13 digits after the plus sign.

panel.heading: Saving a number in +234 format
items: Save it and test the call

say: She saves it under the customer's name and taps call to test it rings.
And remember, 112 is Nigeria's emergency number. You can dial it from the lock screen by tapping Emergency call.

say: SMS needs no internet. One SMS holds 160 plain characters, but adding an emoji drops the limit to 70, so long messages and emoji can cost more.
A bank alert SMS is only a notice. Anyone can type a fake alert, so check your bank app before you release goods.

panel.heading: SMS or WhatsApp?

say: WhatsApp needs data or Wi-Fi, and both people need the app. It sends photos, voice notes and documents. Install it only from the Play Store.

say: For example, Mama Nkechi in Owerri sends her son Emeka a message. First she sees a clock. That means it has not left her phone yet.

items: Clock: not sent yet, no internet

say: One grey tick means it is sent, but has not reached his phone.

panel.heading: How far has my message gone?
items: Clock: not sent yet, no internet

say: Two grey ticks mean it arrived on his phone.

panel.heading: How far has my message gone?
items: Clock: not sent yet, no internet

say: Two blue ticks mean he opened the chat. To send a voice note, she presses and holds the microphone, speaks, and lifts her finger.

say: No bank, network or government office will call and ask for your PIN, your password, or a code sent to your phone. If a caller asks, end the call, and call the organisation yourself on its official number.

panel.heading: Codes that are for you alone

cards.d: No bank, network or government office will call and ask for them. End the call.
Anyone who gets it can take your account. Never send it, even to a friend.
Got one you did not ask for? Do not share it. Change your password or call your bank.

say: Anyone who gets your WhatsApp verification code can take over your account. Never send it to anyone. Switch on two-step verification in WhatsApp settings too.

say: If a one-time code arrives that you did not ask for, someone may be trying to get into your account. Do not share it. And never dial a USSD code a stranger sends you to receive a payment.

say: For example, Patience in Benin City gets a message on Sunday night: all primary schools are closed tomorrow. It is marked Forwarded many times, with no date or office named.

panel.heading: Pause, check, then share or delete

say: She checks the state government's official page and the school's page. There is no announcement.

panel.heading: Pause, check, then share or delete

say: She calls the head teacher on the number from the school's letterhead. School is open as normal.

panel.heading: Pause, check, then share or delete

say: So instead of forwarding, she tells her parents' group of 60 members the truth. Sixty families were not misled by a rumour.

panel.heading: Pause, check, then share or delete
panel.rule: If you cannot confirm it, do not forward it.

say: Name contacts with name, role and place, so search always finds them. Save them to your Google account, so a new phone is just a sign-in away.
Import your SIM contacts and merge duplicates. Add an emergency contact on the lock screen. And ask before sharing someone's number.

say: To remember. Write numbers as plus 234 without the first 0. Confirm money in your bank app, not by SMS. Never share PINs or codes.
Read the ticks, and check before you forward.
